title: Create and query a typed collection
instructions: Create a collection named services in app kv_training. Define field.name=string, field.owner=string and enforceTypes=true. Save at least two records. Use the KV Store page or simulated REST endpoint, then read the records back. Inspect splunk show kvstore-status --verbose and explain the distinction between Splunk 9.4.1 and the fixture KV server 7.0.0.

checks.label: Create a typed services collection with at least two records

completionScope: KV checks validate persisted collection contents, service health and recovery outcomes. Review your explanation separately.
